project_name: Brilliant Grammar School and PU College
archetype: Archetype 4 (Swiss & High-Contrast) + Archetype 5 (Premium Touch) -> 'Modern Academic Prestige'
emotional_tone: Trustworthy, Ambitious, Structured yet Welcoming, Premium

headings.usage: Use for all H1, H2, H3 elements. Represents tradition, prestige, and academic excellence.

body.usage: Use for paragraphs, UI elements, navigation, and data tables. Clean and highly legible.

primary.description: Deep Oxford Navy. Used for strong authority, primary buttons, footers, and hero overlays.

accent.description: Warm Ochre/Gold. Used sparingly for highlights, premium badges, hover states, and critical CTAs to denote prestige.

background.description: Soft Alabaster. Main page background to reduce stark white glare while maintaining clean look.

surface.description: Pure white. Used for cards, form backgrounds, and overlapping bento grids.

rules: No generic full-screen gradients. Keep colors solid, crisp, and high-contrast.
Hover state color must always be explicitly defined.
The 'Tinted Grey' Rule: Grays must feel slightly cool to match the Navy theme.

layout_and_spacing.philosophy: Generous Spacing (Tailwind Scale p-8, p-12, p-24). Allow breathing room for content.

grids.marketing: MODE A: The 'Bento' Grid. Use grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12 with wide gaps (gap-8 to gap-12). Prioritize asymmetry. Mix col-span-4, col-span-8 to create visual tension.
grids.dashboard: MODE B: The 'Control Room' Grid. Dense, strict hierarchy for Admin Panel. grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-4 gap-6.

layout_and_spacing.sections: Padding top/bottom for major sections should be py-16 or py-24.

navigation.classes: sticky top-0 z-50 backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/80 border-b border-gray-200 shadow-sm
navigation.rules: Must have visible links on desktop. Hamburger menu for mobile only. Logo on left, links center, CTA right.

hero_section.layout: Asymmetric split or overlapping deep navy box over the main background image.
hero_section.overlay: If text is over image, use bg-black/40 to bg-black/60. Text MUST have high contrast.
hero_section.animation: Subtle fade up for text, slight parallax or slow scale for background image.

cards.classes: bg-white border border-gray-100 shadow-[0_4px_20px_rgba(0,0,0,0.05)] rounded-xl overflow-hidden transition-all duration-300 hover:-translate-y-1 hover:shadow-[0_8px_30px_rgba(0,0,0,0.08)]

buttons.primary: bg-[#0A192F] text-white px-6 py-3 rounded-none font-medium transition-all hover:bg-[#1E293B]
buttons.secondary: bg-[#D4AF37] text-white px-6 py-3 rounded-none font-medium transition-all hover:bg-[#B4952F]
buttons.outline: border border-[#0A192F] text-[#0A192F] px-6 py-3 rounded-none font-medium transition-all hover:bg-[#0A192F] hover:text-white

forms.style: Inputs must be crisp with rounded-md, border-gray-300 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#0A192F] focus:border-transparent.

admin_dashboard.library: Shadcn UI heavily utilized for Tables, Dialogs, Dropdowns, and Tabs.
admin_dashboard.style: Dense data view, flat solid surfaces, high contrast headers.

motion_and_interaction.hover_states: All interactive elements must change state visually. Add `data-testid` to all.
motion_and_interaction.page_transitions: Framer Motion. Use staggered entrance animations for grid items (0.1s delay increments).
motion_and_interaction.scrolling: If feasible, implement Lenis for smooth momentum scrolling on the marketing pages.

icons_and_assets.usage: Use with 1.5px stroke width for a refined, modern look.

hero_campus.description: Aerial view of a modern educational building. Use for Home page Hero background.

students_collaborating.description: Diverse group of students collaborating. Use for 'About Us' or 'Admissions' sections.
students_collaborating.placement: About Us Page / Home Page Highlight

classroom_lecture.description: Professor teaching students in a lecture hall.

sports_field.description: Aerial view of a sports court.

abstract_texture.description: Abstract white wavy vertical lines pattern. Use as a subtle background layer for text-heavy sections to remove flat digital feeling.
abstract_texture.placement: Backgrounds for Contact/Enquiry or Text blocks

critical_instructions_for_agent: You are building a React frontend and FastAPI backend. Use pure React with Vite if no framework specified, but ensure routing is configured (react-router-dom).
Include `data-testid` on all buttons, links, and forms for testing.
Do NOT use 'Inter' for headings. Use Playfair Display.
Marketing sections (Home, About, Courses, Facilities) must use custom HTML/Tailwind to achieve the Bento layouts and overlapping components.
Use Shadcn UI primarily for the Admin Dashboard and complex forms (Enquiry page).
Never center everything. Asymmetry creates tension and interest.
Ensure email notification is set up via Resend in the backend FastAPI application.
Integrate Gemini 3 Flash for the chatbot feature.
